clauses.text: Every value proof binds one intent_id and one decision_attempt_id and preserves evidence state without guessing.
Ordinary Brainbase references are silent; delegated decisions render only during execution and completion.
Human-required cases explain why AI will not decide and include options with impacts.
Companion receives only human-required, blocked, unconfirmed-outcome, or feedback attention; Web receives none.
Unavailable and unconfirmed evidence are never converted to zero or verified success.
Default user rendering omits internal entity IDs, raw evidence refs, and tool response bodies.
